scripts.script: The tomb shifts around you. Ancient passages grind into new alignments, sealing familiar routes and opening paths into darkness. Find your way through the labyrinth before it closes around you.
The demolition charges are armed, but the tomb will not surrender its secrets willingly. Reach the designated sites, place the explosives, and withdraw before the awakened defenders overwhelm you.
A transponder signal flickers somewhere in the buried complex. Recover the device and carry it beyond the tomb before its guardians silence the signal forever.
At the heart of this chamber stands an ancient sarcophagus, pulsing with dormant power. Break its defenses and destroy it before the tomb fully awakens.
The sub-crypt lies ahead, unmapped and watchful. Advance through its chambers, record what waits within, and survive long enough to bring that knowledge home.
The expedition is scattered and the tomb closes in. Regroup under fire, reach the extraction zone together, and leave no survivor behind.
